controls.what: publish-taxonomy gets write access again (the road back to a direct push)

mutations.old:
permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
mutations.new:
permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false

controls.what: the report no longer reaches the run summary
